# Waiting on customer is a promise

> Waiting-on-customer is neither resolved nor idle — it is a paused clock with a promise attached.


## The heuristic

**Waiting-on-customer is neither resolved nor idle — it is a paused clock with a promise attached.**


_Why:_ It is the most abused state in every ticketing system because it improves the numbers without improving anything. A queue that does not chase it has simply moved its backlog somewhere the dashboard does not look.
